note: The forest roster set (`--roster forest`, crowd.md, Roster sets): Dark and Forest Creatures Pack monsters from the more_assets root, drawn by the stock crowd with their own materials (no typeColors dye). Each type keeps one of the nine slot ids, so the choreography needs no change; a slot this file leaves out keeps the default roster's type (Data/roster.json), and so does the hero. `hide` names prefab children the baker removes (a pack prefab that carries every weapon). ps-f8a.1 proved the plumbing with the mushroom slot; the set beads fill in the rest.
